sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C13487, card C13487-K1. Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-26, 3 transaction(s) (3460634, 3478561, 3489320) totalling $439.61 were identified as suspicious. The activity was conducted online, billed to region(s) 191, with amounts of $112.37, $74.96, $252.28. The transactions came from the device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080', which was used by 27 other customers between 2016-11-14 and 2016-12-04, 100% of the time behind an anonymous proxy and 100% marked as a new device. Other cards on this device include C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K1, C06031-K2, C06650-K2 and others, indicating a common actor across unrelated cardholders. The same device profile appears on previously confirmed fraud cases CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035. Supporting detail: Flagged transaction came from a device marked New for this account (id_15) and behind a proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS). The activity is suspicious because it is inconsistent with the cardholder's established behaviour and matches a coordinated pattern not covered by the bank's documented typologies, as in prior confirmed cases CC-2649, CC-2971. Recommended actions: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST. Total suspicious amount: $439.61.
